timing: Written before any synthesis or protected-case execution; digest sent to coordinating root before results.

grammar.encoding: Every node costs seven description bits: three opcode bits and four parameter bits; all sixteen binary truth tables are generated.
grammar.domain: Loop-free finite Boolean expressions, input arity at most sixteen; duplicate reads charged separately.
grammar.enumeration: Every ordered expression through the registered node bound, quotiented only by full finite outputs and per-input read/opcode/branch/read-mask traces at the same size.

input_order: Lexicographic product of zero and one, first coordinate most significant.

properties.EAGER: No executed branch on any input.
properties.CONDITIONAL: An executed branch on some input and no executed binary opcode on any input.
properties.MIXED: Both a branch and a binary opcode execute somewhere in the complete input domain.

predicted_laws.and2: min(2q+a+21s, q(1+p)+b+28s) at size<=4; all equality fibers retained.
predicted_laws.and3: min(3q+2a+35s, q(1+2p)+ap+b+42s, q(1+p+p*p)+b(1+p)+49s) at size<=7 for the registered scenarios; tested as a prediction, not presumed by ranking.
predicted_laws.parity3: Every exact input transcript reads all three distinct bits; registered positive-cost optima at size<=7 are eager with cost 3q+2a+35s.
predicted_laws.boundary_p_half: For registered q,a,s and p=1/2, CONDITIONAL/MIXED tie at b=29/50 and MIXED/EAGER tie at b=57/50.
